content: SearXNG self-host: JSON output DISABLED by default - must add '- json' under search.formats in settings.yml (required for API/OWUI integration). Engines enabled/disabled in settings.yml or via comma-list API param. time_range supported per-engine (URL param, empty when none). safesearch levels 0=none/1=moderate/2=strict per-engine. limiter (bot detection) BLOCKS API access - must set limiter:false for programmatic use; official Docker image ships Redis for rate limiting. Upstream engines (Google/Bing) may rate-limit/CAPTCHA under load. Needs a secret_key.
